properties.notes: The site is allocated for a retail-led mixed use development (which could include housing or student accommodation) in the Sites and Housing Plan adopted in February 2013. The site is also allocated in the emerging Local Plan 2036, which is currently undergoing an examination in public (consultation on proposed modifications following hearings). The City Council has adopted the Diamond Place SPD to guide development on this site.
properties.site-address: Ewert House, Ewert Place, Oxford, OX2 7DD, (Diamond Place and Ewert House)
